reviews.title: One of my favorites. Perfect balance of hunt and find.
reviews.body: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.One of the best murder mystery logic books I have done. The clues were a perfect mix of deleting some chunks to narrow down more specific clues but not giving too much away that it could be completely fast. Loved the addition of the face profiles too. Many of these books I have done either get repetitive because it’s just going line by line or too many clues delete too much too fast. This one was the perfect balance of hunt and find, keeping it interesting while taking time. If you like the Alice book you will love this one too. Thank you and I just ordered the 3rd one. Can’t wait to start it.Read moreRead less
